title: Eli Norwood
repository: Delaware Native American Archives / Mitsawokett Collection
transcriber: Archival Transcriber / Written in the Genome
citation: "Eli Norwood." Historical Document Record (1838). Preserved in the Nanticoke & Moor Historical Archive (Written in the Genome Collection).
lines: Sussex County probate index card, Estate of Eli Norwood. Date Jan. 2, 1838; probated May 23, 1838. Archives Volume A91, pages 113-114, Register of Wills. Administratrix: Elon Norwood. Heirs per the card's note (Arch. Vol. A91, p. 114): widow Elon Norwood and 7 children, Eli, Stephen D., William D., Wingate P., Samuel B., Mary Jane Whittington, and Ann Johnson; and issue of son John (Charles and Benjamin Norwood).
